game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Snowdrift Barracks, barracks half buried in snow: the firewood keeper must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Default Armory: Use default parameter values so the armory works even when arguments are missing.
theme: Snowy Hold – Snowdrift Barracks: barracks half buried in snow
core_gameplay_loop: In Snowdrift Barracks, repeat each round: Use default parameter values so the armory works even when arguments are missing. Each round, winter bandits strike the beacon fire, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the armor value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the beacon fire from winter bandits in Snowdrift Barracks: keep the armor meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 30-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: armor drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 30-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 1 (intro tier): Default Armory
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how armor changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against winter bandits in Snowdrift Barracks.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 30 seconds while armor > 0.
